status: proposal_only; no capacity point or positive-bank test executed by reviewer
objective: Establish real capacity at unchanged guard phases and test bounded CPU/GPU parallel work

fixed_profile.other_profile_fields: retain current pinned launch including NUMA/affinity/cache plan; save actual values

phase_definitions.when: fresh main context reserve complete, before explicit vision init/warmup
phase_definitions.use: baseline corresponding point; not a substitute for actual bank Gpre

phase_definitions.when: target 1024-token prefill and short T1/synchronize complete
inside original hot initialize after main reserve, before vision
private bank reachable-H warmup and synchronize complete, still before vision

phase_definitions.use: record actual remaining free and growth; no new threshold under the old guard name

phase_rules.CUDA_and_NVML: save separately with timestamps; never mix accounting or phases

decision_order: Fresh1024 M0-M3 measurement, provider and input consistency.
If small bank is plausible at M0, test actual candidate Gpre/Gpost plus later warmup; a valid bounded pilot need not wait for ubatch512.
If more capacity is needed, compare ubatch512 in the same isolated caller with all other settings pinned.
For promising capacity point, add three targeted tails and one representative timing workload.
Try ubatch256 only if measured phase/arena evidence makes another capacity point informative.
If bytes cannot be attributed enough to select a next change, optional one-shot reserve inventory; no permanent observer framework.
Proceed to staged train5/train5/validation5/freeze/holdout5 only as justified by real capacity and measured benefit.

capacity_text.input_form: raw text; same saved flags and IDs for both arms

profiles.role: conditional follow-up, not an automatic grid

numerical.saved_outputs_per_case: final-prefix logits plus next 4 T1 output vectors, all 129280 F32
numerical.short64_comparison: byte comparison against same workload baseline
numerical.acceptance_policy: predeclare against existing CPU/CUDA policy; undefined tolerance yields diagnostic only, not fabricated pass
numerical.matched_partition_control: only if an observed difference affects the decision; hold output mask constant

timing.endpoints: decode begin to output ready; retain full timestamps
timing.validation_scope: same per arm; keep F32/JSON disk writes out of timed loop
timing.transfer_observation: if available, per-chunk expert union and transfer bytes plus full-prefix total; not mandatory new per-token framework

caller_changes: expected n_ubatch difference allowed explicitly, all other cparams/provider/placement checks preserved
preallocate steps and final export only
record actual split lengths, not assumed lengths

parallel_cost_definition.C: CPU result complete minus common fork; include delayed CPU start
parallel_cost_definition.G: GPU result consumable minus same fork; include real queue/transfer/compute/return
parallel_cost_definition.unknown_ready_policy: use bound/unknown and actual mixed wall; add detailed ready observation only if decision needs it
parallel_cost_definition.hit_states: all reachable H and representative mixtures; H6 not mandatory if unrepresentable
parallel_cost_definition.miss_path: no unnecessary hot input copy, enqueue or hot stream synchronization at H0; preserve required dependencies

not_required_as_preconditions: same F/D suite repeated without new reason
automatic adoption from free improvement alone
